stages.name: Build
stages.plain: Packages the code and runs the fast tests. Catches anything that is simply broken.

stages.name: Beta
stages.plain: Runs the service in a test environment and checks that its parts still work together.

stages.name: Gamma
stages.plain: A copy of production with no real customers. The last rehearsal before the real thing.

stages.name: One-box
stages.plain: One real host gets the new code and serves a small share of customers, while alarms are watched.
stages.message: 📦 One-box · {ticket} · one host served 10% of traffic through its bake time. No alarms.

stages.name: Prod
stages.plain: Every host gets the new code, a few at a time. All customers now run your change.
stages.message: 🚀 Prod · {ticket} · deployed to all hosts. No alarms.

history.note: The error-rate alarm fired after four minutes at One-box. The pipeline undid the change by itself; 10% of traffic was affected for four minutes instead of everyone for hours. Dev fixed it and shipped again the next day.
